NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.0375 (<= iter-7 best), train_n/data-coverage does NOT lift this VN (consistent with the old-metric train_n 200->300 FLAT probe on the tiny 0.018M VN) -> the Hammernik-2017 image-domain learned-regularizer family is STRUCTURALLY FBP-BOUNDED on Mayo at hr~0.037, all single knobs (epochs/bs/lr/lambda/n_filters/vn_T/train_n) mapped, and the budget-bounded ceiling is DOCUMENTED as a negative result.
